text: 54, the sports and entertainment agency owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), was named lead investor in the Hexagon World Series, a new FIP-governed team padel circuit; SportBusiness called it Saudi Arabia's first major investment move into padel. FIP's own release describes 54's investment without using the phrase 'lead investor' and does not mention PIF.
short: 54, owned by Saudi PIF, is lead investor in the Hexagon World Series

source.name: SportBusiness (via Wayback Machine) - PIF enters padel as 54 gets new Hexagon event remit
